findings.title: Joined inscription and gathered recitation
findings.claim: Within the opening 12:1-12:3 pericope, the Arabic Qur'an is perceptible as a form in which distinguishable marks are joined, gathered into recitation, and disclosed for understanding.
findings.mechanism: The preceding signs, book, and manifestation at 12:1 supply composition and disclosure; the focus forms Qur'an and Arabic carry gathering and clear expression, while 12:3 repeats the recitation in a narrated sequence. Their contact turns intelligibility into an operation performed on joined material.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader can see why the focus names both a recitation and its Arabic qualification: the qualification can describe how an assembled form becomes available to understanding, not only which language it uses.
findings.containment: The plain reading remains that God sent down the Qur'an as an Arabic recitation so the audience may understand. The writing and joining image is a local pericope analogy, not an etymological replacement, an exhaustive theory of Arabic, or a claim that the text is materially present as an inscription in every moment.

findings.mechanism: The focus placement facet of descent and the gathering form contact casting into a hollow, concealment, deliberate placement, convergent decision, and hidden imparting. Descent therefore acquires an attributed emplacement image: communication can enter a low unseen receptacle before its import is disclosed.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader can perceive descent as more than vertical movement: it can describe how something is placed within a hidden situation and later brought back into understanding.
findings.containment: The plain reading remains that the Qur'an was sent down as an Arabic recitation. The well and hidden-knowledge image is a qualified attributed HFT resonance in this pericope; unresolved context branches have no supplied lexical gloss, and no physical equivalence between revelation and Yusuf's well is asserted.

epistemic.reason: The exact focus and context coordinates are supplied, while seven contextual branch records are unresolved and the narrative-scale replay is legacy_unbound HFT evidence.

findings.reader_payoff: The reader can see understanding as binding words and surfaces to one another and remaining able to reject an account whose traces do not hold.
findings.containment: The ordinary reading remains the sending of an Arabic Qur'an for understanding. This is a qualified attributed pericope inference, not a claim that Arabic entails deception or that the episode's speakers establish a universal theory of evidence.

findings.title: Reason held open
findings.claim: The focus reasoning word can be perceived as preserving uncertainty responsibly: reaction is restrained, a failed surface is rejected, and multiple possibilities remain tethered until further traces arrive.
findings.mechanism: The focus cognitive and tethering facets contact falsehood, motivated selves, self-restraint, and valued composure in 12:18. Reasoning therefore becomes an interval that holds an account open after its presented evidence has failed, while composure keeps uncertainty from becoming panic.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader can perceive understanding as a disciplined pause that still thinks, rather than as a rush toward the most intelligible account.
findings.containment: The plain reading remains the purpose of sending the Arabic Qur'an: the audience is invited to understand it. This attributed HFT resonance adds a mode of reasoning under pressure; it does not make patience the only meaning of تَعْقِلُونَ or settle the episode's unresolved facts.
